producer_attempts.definition: IMPLEMENT invocations that published a candidate; excludes the authority-blocked invocation and the closure invocation

blocking_findings_count.definition: F1-F12, V1-V14, W1-W11, X1-X10, Y1-Y8 and the cycle-6 set {Y2,Y4,Z1}, counting each verifier report's own enumerated findings: 12+14+11+10+8+3+0. A finding carried into a later cycle is counted again in that cycle, so this measures reported findings per cycle and not distinct defects.

decisive_findings_by_cycle.definition: findings the verifier explicitly labelled '(decisive)'. Cycle 1 used no decisive label.

findings_by_class.note: evidence-local classification of each verifier report's own enumerated findings, over the same 58-report population as blocking_findings_count; not v1 schema authority. PROCESS_INSTRUCTION_ADHERENCE is the assigned diagnostic-coalescing debt reported absent in two consecutive cycles.

candidate_added_lines_by_cycle.definition: added lines of each candidate against its own parent, from Git. The coordinator's separate series 197 -> 314 -> 545 is cumulative added lines over the release baseline and must not be conflated with this one.

human_decisions_required.scope: the coordinator classified the FOUNDER_EXCEPTION as contracted work inside approved scope; no Founder decision was requested or supplied

false_or_escalated_authority_requests.definition: the producer claimed PY-08 could not produce a compliant candidate without broader authority; the coordinator checked all four claimed blockers against the landed tree and found each in scope

human_attention_blocked_seconds.definition: FOUNDER_EXCEPTION comment 22:25:41Z to coordinator response comment 22:27:55Z

liveness_incidents.definition: one LIVENESS_GAP for issue 56 at state age 575 s against a 300 s grace

operator_interventions.definition: one operator status re-emission IMPLEMENT -> READY -> IMPLEMENT applied as liveness recovery

attention_items.definition: judgment-required durable attention items: one FOUNDER_EXCEPTION item and four repeated-rejection threshold items. Excludes the DONE_TO_DONE notification.

candidate_custody_failures.scope: seven published candidates; the verifier retrieved each from origin into a fresh independent worktree and confirmed ancestry from the authorized baseline

architecture_violations.scope: architecture fitness PASS at each candidate from cycle 3 onward and on the merge result

proof_regression_count.definition: SWF-23 regressions: X1/Y1, AC 7 regressed from working to unreachable and stayed so for two cycles; Y3, operator diagnostics that worked at two prior candidates were removed

behavioral_regression_count.definition: the same two events, counted as behaviour as well as proof: AC 7 became unreachable and diagnostics disappeared

defects_introduced_by_repair.definition: X3 VersionConflict undefined (NameError, never executed successfully once); X5 status writes the store; Y2 stop silently ignores --expected-version, introduced by the X3 repair

never_attempted_obligations.definition: AC 4's proof that explain reproduces the kernel's own decision, and the verification requirements' subprocess / negative-control / backdoor coverage. Untouched across five consecutive repair cycles; both closed in the single verification-only cycle 6.

proven_red_evidence.cycle_6: AC 4 tested against a real kernel over a real store; four subprocess tests with real exit statuses including readiness refusal and stale-mutation rejection

implementation_elapsed_seconds.definition: sum of the seven candidate-producing PRODUCER invocation durations; excludes the 1,043 s authority-blocked invocation and the 487 s closure invocation

verification_elapsed_seconds.definition: sum of the seven VERIFIER invocation durations

issue_closure_lag_seconds.definition: DONE observation to Issue closed_at 01:02:59Z, under SWF-31

provider_capacity_failures.scope: no capacity failure appears in Issue #56 comments or the observation log

known_provider_model.note: the dispatcher state record carries no provider or model field

repair_mode.basis: cycles 1-5 closed findings while shipping fresh defects, including two SWF-23 regressions and three newly introduced defects, with the AC 4 proof and verification requirements untouched throughout. Findings fell 14 -> 11 -> 10 -> 8 without acceptance. Cycle 6, directed to build only the missing proof plus the outstanding regressions, produced 3 findings all carried and none fresh; cycle 7 produced 0. The mode change is attributable to a direction, not to a smaller contract.

carried_scope_debt_at_accept.definition: Y7, status reports wip as len(items) and counts terminal and cancelled work, which the verifier states actively misinforms an operator; Y8, only status logs and no mutating command does. Recorded not waived; neither maps to a numbered acceptance criterion.
